name: Hattori Hanzo Kazemasa
source:
"I want you in my arms forever."

Name: Hattori Hanzo Kazemasa
Height: 5ft 10in
Birthplace: Wind Village
Weapon: Large Sword

He is the son of the Wind Village chieftain. He always thinks of the benefits of his village as the first priority and excludes any hampering things. Because of his reliability in completing his missions, he is a highly respected ninja.

Hattori Hanzo Kazemasa's Special Attack: Piercing Storm Edge

He spins his body to create a tornado around him, draws his sword and pierces his enemy as if he were a gigantic drill.

[Official in-game description]
